incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — elevated 5xxs on /v1/generate and sudden KV prefix cache miss-rate spike. Error rate ~7.8% (baseline ~0.2%). Prefix miss rate jumped 4.7% -> 69% in last 10m. Paging @oncall.

Aisha: I'm oncall, looking now. Main customer impact: hosted API tail latency and errors; a dedicated EU tenant reporting degraded throughput. Priya / Tom — can you pull invalidation and deploy history for the last hour? I'll collect metrics and start a timeline.

Priya: grabbing invalidator logs. I see a scheduled invalidation job started just before the spike.

Priya: logs:
```
[14:02:03] invalidator: started job id=inv-2026-04-12-3 prefixes=42-47 pattern=client-prefix-*
[14:02:10] cache-api: delete batch=512 status=200 shard=43
[14:05:51] cache-api: delete batch=512 status=200 shard=44
[14:06:30] cache-api: delete batch=512 status=200 shard=45
[14:07:12] invalidator: finished job id=inv-2026-04-12-3 deleted=12800 keys
```

Tom: deploy-bot shows a config rollout right before that window.

deploy-bot: Completed rollout config/cache/invalidation v2.1 -> toggled aggressive-eviction=true (initiated by release/ops). Canary success at 14:01:48.

Tom: pulling cache metrics (short snippet):
```
metric: prefix_hit_rate
- 13:55 -> 0.952
- 14:05 -> 0.47
- 14:10 -> 0.31
- 14:20 -> 0.28
metric: 5xx_rate
- 13:55 -> 0.002
- 14:10 -> 0.065
```

Jules: hypothesis 1 (H1): invalidation job + new aggressive-eviction config caused mass eviction of long-tail prefixes -> warmup gap = cache miss spike.
Jules: hypothesis 2 (H2): KV reuse bug where evicted keys aren't re-associated to new shard owners during rewarm, causing sustained misses for certain prefix ranges.

Aisha: initial mitigation plan:
- Pause invalidation jobs
- Rollback aggressive-eviction config to v2.0
- Trigger rewarm for top prefixes and route a fraction of traffic to warmed nodes
- Monitor hitrate and errors, escalate if no recovery in 30m

Priya: pausing invalidation jobs now -> API call: `POST /admin/invalidator/pause` -> response 200 OK (inv-system: paused)

ops-runner: kicked rewarm script: `/opt/infra/bin/rewarm_prefixes --top 200 --concurrency 8` -> job id=rewarm-18901

Tom: issued rollback to config/cache/invalidation v2.0. Rollback completed (rolling update) at ~14:18.

Aisha: putting short timeline in-thread to seed RCA doc:
- ~14:01:48 config/cache/invalidation v2.1 rolled
- ~14:02:03 invalidator inv-2026-04-12-3 started (prefixes 42-47)
- 14:05-14:12 prefix hitrate falls sharply; 5xxs increase at ~14:10
- 14:12-14:20 mitigation actions: pause invalidator, rollback config, trigger rewarm
- 14:28 hitrate first noticeable recovery; 14:45 error rate back near baseline

Priya: quick cache-stats sample (from cache-admin):
```
shard=43 prefixes_evicted=12800 rewarm_inflight=0 prefix_miss_rate=0.68
shard=44 prefixes_evicted=12432 rewarm_inflight=12 prefix_miss_rate=0.71
```

Jules: marking hypotheses in-thread for tracking:
- H1 (open): scope too-broad invalidation + aggressive eviction. Evidence: timing of rollout + invalidator logs + immediate hitrate drop.
- H2 (open): rewarm/rehydration bug for certain prefix ranges. Evidence: non-uniform recovery across shards, rewarm_inflight=0 on some shards despite rewarm job.

Tom: I ran targeted queries against the cache control API for a problematic prefix (client-prefix-4821):
```
GET /cache/prefix/client-prefix-4821/stats
=> {"last_access": "2026-04-12T13:58:21Z", "exists": false, "rehydration_attempts": 0}
```

Aisha: mitigation status update: pause + rollback + rewarm triggered. Routing rule applied: tag traffic with `kv-warmed=true` to warmed nodes (10% ramp to start). Monitoring dashboards:
- https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/db/cache-prefixs
- https://logs.redwood/orgs/ops/query?q=inv-2026-04-12-3

ops-runner: rewarm job logs (tail):
```
[14:22:05] rewarm: started job id=rewarm-18901 candidates=200
[14:26:15] rewarm: batch 1/25 done, populated=480
[14:29:50] rewarm: batch 10/25 done, populated=5200
```

Priya: observing recovery signals: shard 43 prefix_miss_rate -> 0.35 at 14:35; errors down to 0.9% overall.

Jules: action items for RCA (in-thread):
- (A) Add guardrail to invalidation config: max-deletes-per-shard and percent-threshold
- (B) Make aggressive-eviction toggles gated behind canary with synthetic warmup run
- (C) Confirm rewarm orchestration respects shard ownership and increases parallelism for long-tail prefixes
- (D) Add richer telemetry on rehydration attempts per-prefix

Aisha: agreed. I'll take (A) and (B). Priya take (C). Tom take (D). Will collect artifacts for postmortem: invalidator logs, deploy timeline, rewarm logs, per-prefix hit-rate dump.

Tom: note — we should also add a runbook step: if >30% of top-200 prefixes evicted within 10m, auto-pause invalidator and trigger rewarm.

Aisha: de-escalation: customer-facing SRE notified, support issued mitigation notes. I'll start formal incident doc and assign owners for action items. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident marked as "mitigated" at 14:50 UTC by Aisha. Will post follow-up RCA in #postmortems and link back here.

Jules: leaving this thread open for additional logs / notes. I'll update the hypothesis statuses in the RCA doc once we validate rewarm plumbing.
